en.text:
While at full Sword Energy, sprinting for 1 second grants 'Temporal Sprint' until you are no longer sprinting.

Performing a Grounded Heavy Attack with Temporal Sprint launches a teleporting Blink Attack, draining 50% Sword Energy and teleporting you 10 meters forward. 

The Blink Attack consumes 3 ammo and deals up to <pve 530 /> <pvp [353] /> damage 7 times to all enemies within 2 meters of the teleportation path.

Scoring a kill with this attack grants Temporal Sprint again for 2 seconds, and allows you to perform an additional Blink Attack that only costs 1 ammo and 10% sword energy.
